item: 1 Drive module subframe and preload springs
spec: 6 mm steel top plate 250 x 360 mm clamped to the donor steering yoke with a tongue under the yoke plate, two 6 mm doubled trailing cheeks carrying the drive axle 180 mm behind the steering axis, two compression springs giving 1.5 kN preload on the drive wheels together, over-center cam seat for the release lever
notes: Estimate for one prototype; clamp pattern depends on the donor yoke (R1 survey); bolt-on only; about 9.6 kg

spec: 24 V brushless gearless hub servo motor, 200 mm (8 in) polyurethane or rubber tread, 12 N m or more continuous and 30 N m or more peak, fail-safe brake 20 N m or more dynamic, encoder, IP54 or better, about 7 kg
supplier: AGV hub motor maker (ZLTECH or UU Motor class)
notes: Per motor; class prices USD 165 (UU Motor SVB8S; 20/40 N m; 36 to 48 V; no brake listed) to USD 249 (ZLTECH 8 in 24/48 V; 40/80 N m); brake option and 24 V winding to confirm; TRL 2 figure of $170 was for a 16 N m class motor that is too weak

spec: Folded 2 mm aluminium box 270 x 300 x 95 mm with lid, cable glands, IP54; height set so the donor handle clears it when lowered to horizontal
8S 25.6 V 20 Ah (512 Wh) LiFePO4, 8S6P 26650 cells in three layers about 270 x 115 x 85 mm, BMS 50 A continuous, charge temperature cut-off below 0 degC
notes: Estimate from retail 24 V 20 Ah packs; about 4.9 kg; 410 Wh usable at 80 % depth of discharge

spec: 24 V dual-channel brushless servo driver for the hub motors, 2 x 15 A continuous and 30 A peak, CAN, brake outputs
supplier: AGV hub motor maker (sold with the motors)
notes: Estimate; match to the chosen motor's encoder and brake

spec: 80 A main fuse at the pack terminal, two 24 V main contactors in series (each opened by one safety relay channel) with pre-charge resistor, lockable battery disconnect
notes: Estimate; second contactor (about USD 30) added for a dual-channel stop chain toward PL d (PLP-DDR-002; O6); about 1.1 kg

spec: ESP32-S3 class controller with CAN transceiver, UWB SPI links and lidar UART; dual-channel safety relay for the stop chain
notes: Estimate (controller about $25; safety relay about $60); firmware is not TRL 3 work

spec: Clamp-on head replacing the grip: thumbwheel throttle, belly-reverse paddle, mode key switch (walk or follow), horn button, beacon mount
22 mm red mushroom pushbutton, twist release, two normally closed contacts, yellow backing plate (ISO 13850 style)
notes: Per unit; one on the tiller head and one on the enclosure rear face

spec: Pressure-sensitive safety edge about 1.3 m long with evaluation unit, 40 mm compression travel, on a 40 x 20 x 2 mm steel tube U hoop
notes: Estimate; last stopping layer; about 3.5 kg with hoop

spec: Qorvo DWM3000 class UWB module on a carrier board: two on the bumper corners (450 mm baseline), one on the tiller head
24 V LED beacon on the tiller head, amber in walk mode and blue in follow mode, with travel buzzer
notes: Estimate; moved from the lid to the tiller head so the lowered handle clears the enclosure

spec: 400 mm over-center lever and cam that raise the spring seats and lift the drive wheels clear of the floor
Certified 29.2 V 5 A LiFePO4 charger, 100 to 240 V AC input
notes: Estimate; not modelled; stays at the charging point

spec: Belt tag with UWB module, rechargeable cell, stop button and vibration alert

item: 16 Handle angle sensor and gas spring
spec: Hall angle sensor on the handle pivot; gas spring that holds the handle upright in follow mode
10 AWG power cable, spiral wrap to the tiller head, connectors, fasteners, labels

2D time-of-flight lidar, 360 deg scan at about 10 Hz, 12 m range on white and 6 m on black targets (Slamtec RPLIDAR C1 class), on a steel bracket from the subframe with its scan plane 200 mm above the floor
supplier: DFRobot (RPLIDAR C1 USD 69) plus local fabricator
notes: USD 69 lidar plus about USD 11 bracket; approved option 1A stopping layer; not safety-rated
